title: triticum flexum
intro: Triticum flexum, commonly known as broomcorn, is a plant species within the wheat genus. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels and reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Triticum flexum include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic applications of this plant.
